references.authors: LeBlanc DJ, Lee LN, Inamine JM
references.title: Cloning and nucleotide base sequence analysis of a spectinomycin adenyltransferase AAD(9) determinant from Enterococcus faecalis.

label: SpecR
note: Full-length AAD(9) as deposited: translated from a GTG start (as Met) 31 codons upstream of the internal Met32 that many vector maps annotate as the start, giving a 224 aa CDS. UniProt's structure-derived secondary structure places a helix at residues 8-23 and a beta strand at 27-34, so the first 31 residues are part of the fold.

provenance.sequence_source: M69221 (Enterococcus faecalis aad9/spc; LeBlanc et al. 1991) CDS 271..1038, GTG start translated as Met, protein AAA16527.1, identical over 255 aa; UniProt:Q07448. This replaces a 224 aa form (residues 32-255, starting at the internal Met32) that is deposited only as cloning-vector CDS annotations; most of those vector records carry the full GTG ORF in frame.
